messages:
maria_cs: Quick QBR note — Acme scheduled Thurs 10am PT. They hit an unexpected embeddings surge; onboarding still ~70% complete. Need: token economics summary + a short mitigation plan we can run live if they spike. Can someone pull last 14d token burn + 3-mo forecast? @alex_finops @sam_se

alex_finops: On it. I'll paste quick numbers in a sec. FYI projected monthly run-rate if current trend continues: ~ $42k/mo (tokens). Risk: a 30% kicker after their feature launch. Recommend two options: 1) short reserved capacity commit (2 wks), 2) set soft budget alert at 60% then hard throttle at 85%.

jonathan_pm: Also want one slide that maps impact to key flows (search embeddings + chat). Can you highlight top-3 prompts that drive burn? I can take the customer-facing framing.

sam_se: I can ship a mitigation script + rate-limit policy. Suggest batching embeddings to 16 and enable prefix cache for the chat path. Quick config snippet:
```
policy.set --account acme --embedding_batch=16 --prefix_cache=true
alerts.config --account acme --soft=60 --hard=85
```

alex_finops: paste: last14d tokens: [1.2M, 1.4M, 1.6M, 1.9M, 2.3M, 2.8M, 3.5M, 4.1M, 4.6M, 5.0M, 5.5M, 6.0M, 6.6M, 7.2M] -> 7.2M latest day. Simple linear forecast + launch uplift -> ~210M tokens/mo -> ~$52k/mo. Preparing a one-slide table for QBR with conservative and upside scenarios.

maria_cs: :eyes: wow. Can we set automated alerts now? Need to inform CS + their finance owner before the QBR. @jonathan_pm who should be on the call from product?

jonathan_pm: I'll join and bring the search PM. Also want to schedule a 20-min pre-QBR runbook review with Acme ops tomorrow. Maria, can you coordinate?

maria_cs: Booking now — will send calendar invite + pre-read. Also capturing customer feedback: Acme flagged that embedding batching docs/examples are thin; we should add a quickstart snippet to reduce risky patterns.

eng-bot: deploy-bot: policy change PR merged: refs/changes/acme-rate-limit -> main (CI passed) :white_check_mark:

ops_bot: ops-bot: alert rule created: acme-soft-budget (60%), acme-hard-budget (85%). Test trigger available at /ops/test-alerts

sam_se: :thumbsup: I'll run the mitigation script during the pre-QBR dry-run. After that we can demo projected savings on the slide.

maria_cs: Action items: alex -> final slide + numbers; sam -> mitigation script + runbook; jonathan -> product impact bullets; me -> invite + customer comms draft. I'll post an updated thread once slides are ready. cc: @alex_finops @sam_se @jonathan_pm
